sentences.en: She's intent on going to New York to study fashion.
sentences.zh: 她一心想要去纽约学习时装。

sentences.en: Once they came in, Levi's never went out of fashion.
sentences.zh: 他们一进来，Levi's 就成了经典，从不落伍。

sentences.en: Fashions of thirty years ago have come back in style.
sentences.zh: 三十年前的流行风格又回来了。
